description: This file defines a React functional component 'ContactOptionRender' that displays contact information using Material-UI components and react-admin hook. It also exports two constants for rendering or formatting contact data.

methods.name: ContactOptionRender
methods.description: A React component that renders a contact's avatar and details, fetching the contact data via react-admin's useRecordContext hook.

methods.name: contactInputText
methods.description: A function that formats a contact choice object into a string combining first and last name.
